name: Sharp dip in a 6-month leader
author: claude
hypothesis: A 7%+ five-session fall in a stock up 15%+ over 120 sessions and still above its 200-day, with a firm close today and VIX calm, is a pullback in a leader and bounces within a week.
filter: ret_5 < -{drop} and ret_120 > {mom} and dist_ma200 > 0 and close_loc_1 > 0.5 and vix < {vix_max} and not avoid
